jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 건축인허가 동별개요 lane `building-permit-building-outline` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_building_outline already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed buildings' rows and a removal marker per vanished building (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, about 2.5x the nearest larger measured neighbours on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release, _parking 251 s for 59 MB, _demolition_loss 161 s for 15 MB; this lane's newest release is about 316 MB in the Bronze ledger (2026-11-09)

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed once, on its first load.

assets.title: 건축인허가 동별개요
assets.description: 허가의 동마다 한 행: 주·부속 구분, 주용도, 구조·지붕, 건축면적·연면적·용적률산정연면적, 호·가구·세대 수, 승강기 수. 필지에 허가된 건물 하나하나를 말하고 관리허가대장PK 로 기본개요의 허가에 붙는다. 원문 29칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-building-permits 가 행의 PNU 로 필지 문서의 목록 하나로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0402, ADR-0464).

dependencies.description: 건축인허가 동별개요(mart_kcy_02) 29칸을 관리동별개요PK 마다 바뀐 동만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0402).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; HUB 대지구분 2 (블록) composes none (FP-ADR-0023); merged, split or recoded parcels are carried to the current pnu by the consumer through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0402)
